Container.Name: R2C-Magic
Container.Overview:
R2C Magic ingests Lightspeed R-Series book export CSVs, enriches each book by ISBN/EAN against public catalogs (Google Books, Open Library, KB SRU), and produces a Lightspeed C-Series import CSV for the rokko bookshop coop's webshop.
Data (SQLite database, uploaded CSVs, and generated exports) is stored in the /app/data directory — map it to a persistent appdata share. Set PUID/PGID to match that share's owner (Unraid default: nobody:users = 99:100) so the app can write its SQLite database.
The R-to-C field mapping lives in mapping.config.json; mount your own copy read-only to customize it, or leave the container's bundled default.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port the web interface listens on.

Config.Name: Data Directory
Config.Description: Persistent storage for the SQLite database, uploaded CSVs, and generated exports.

Config.Name: Mapping Config (optional)
Config.Description: Optional: mount your own R-to-C mapping.config.json read-only to override the bundled default. Leave blank to use the container's version.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID that owns the data directory. Unraid default is 99 (nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID that owns the data directory. Unraid default is 100 (users).

Config.Name: DATABASE_URL
Config.Description: Path to the SQLite database file. Must live inside the Data Directory.

Config.Name: DATA_DIR
Config.Description: Base directory for per-run files. Should match the Data Directory mount.

Config.Name: Google Books API Key (optional)
Config.Description: Optional Google Books API key to raise enrichment rate limits.

Config.Name: Enrichment Concurrency
Config.Description: How many books to enrich in parallel.

Config.Name: Log Level
Config.Description: One of: trace, debug, info, warn, error, fatal.
